name: greek-to-me
description: It's all Greek to me: the shell commands in Claude Code's tool-call peeks are drawn in Greek, Tolkien's Quenya, Tengwar or Cirth, Klingon, Aurebesh or a grimdark script of the mod's own, or an alphabet you supply, instead of Latin.

script.title: Script
script.description: What shell commands are drawn in. greek is the default. quenya, tengwar, cirth and klingon use private-use codepoints and aurebesh a plane-15 copy of the font, which ship in fonts/ and need installing; grimdark needs a font with alchemical symbols. custom uses the alphabet below, in any font you have. A script the mod no longer has falls back to greek.

alphabet.title: Custom alphabet
alphabet.description: For script = custom: your own letters, a to z in order, 26 characters (or 52: the capitals after the lower case). Spaces are ignored. One cell wide each; wide or joining scripts will not line up. Anything else falls back to greek. The README has alphabets to paste in.

keep.title: Keep readable
keep.description: Fence languages left alone when Code in replies is on. Comma-separated.

traces.title: Tool traces
traces.description: Draw shell commands, in the peek of a running call and in their collapsed rows, in the chosen script. Names and paths stay readable. Other tools are never drawn in script.

replies.title: Code in replies
replies.description: Also draw fenced code in the model's replies in the chosen script. Off by default: only tool-call traces change.
